name: smwmusic-trials-of-mana-left-handed-wolf
title: Trials of Mana - Left-Handed Wolf
description:
A dark, steady theme, that will fit a castle or a tense scene.
May be fittier for overworld, and levels that feature slow scrolling.

I had fun with the SMW arrangement of this one, especially for #2 and #4, I hope you'll enjoy as much as I did.

This track originally is featured in a castle that hosts a werewolf tribe; in a world where Full Moon never stops.
